queries: WITH c AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM scanqc q JOIN projects p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux) SELECT fundflux, qc_count, qc_count * 1.0 / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, qc_count * 1.0 / AVG(qc_count * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg FROM c ORDER BY qc_count DESC

assumptions.assumption: Each scanqc row is one QC record; an inner join drops QC rows with no matching project, and projects with no QC records are not counted as funding-source groups (so they do not affect the average).
A NULL fundflux forms its own group (GROUP BY does this natively and it is shown as NULL). Empty-string or other placeholder values are treated as ordinary distinct funding sources.
The average count per funding source is the mean of the group counts across the funding-source groups that appear, including the NULL group.

assumptions.assumption: Each scanqc row is one QC record; the count is the number of matched scanqc rows per funding source (inner join drops unmatched QC records).
A NULL fundflux is kept as its own group (GROUP BY puts NULLs together); the average per funding source is taken over all groups including the NULL group.

responses.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM scanqc q JOIN projects p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux) SELECT fundflux, qc_count, qc_count * 1.0 / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, qc_count * 1.0 / AVG(qc_count * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg_per_source FROM c ORDER BY qc_count DESC

assumptions.assumption: Each scanqc row counts as one QC record; the inner join drops QC rows with no matching project.

A NULL fundflux forms its own group (GROUP BY puts NULLs together) and counts as one funding source in the total and in the average per source. Only groups with at least one matched QC record appear, so the average is over those groups.
